reviews.x: These ears were a great value. Obviously these aren't the types of ears you would find at the parks, but for the price they are fantastic. My daughter started at "Disney Club" at school and these were the perfect little addition to their club! They are well made and they arrived in perfect condition. I was a little worried that the ears would be floppy and they would feel like they were going to fall apart, but that is not the case at all. I would definitely recommend this item.
We bought this for a first disney trip with baby and we loved it, it's so comfortable and pretty at the same time.It fits all ages, me and my daughter both wore it and got some amazing pictures.
I got these to craft my own Disney ears. They're soft and fit any size.
Bought for 2 year old Mickey Mouse themed party. I was so surprised with the quality for the price. I would definitely recommend these ears!!
Great option for a lot of Mickey and Minnie ears for a affordable price.
Good quality and fit both kids and adults.
Huge hit at our party - Arrived within 24 hours of ordering and about 5 mins after the party started :) Thank you!
These are super cute! Got them for my daughters birthday, you can’t beat the price and how many you get.
Kids loved these. Used for kids birthday party

First of all, I'm so  happy to bought so many hair bands at such a low price. But when I received these  product, I was a little disappointed. The ear was two laps smaller than Disney original product  (of course, this was what I expected), but what made me unacceptable was the white glue and strong smell on their ears. It is not recommended that to child wear it for a long time. What is embarrassing is that some of the bows are peeled off when I tap the ear to try to clean the dust. In addition

Good quality ears, none got broken! Even with smaller children (1 -4 years). Definitely worth it! I handed the ears out to all the party attendees as they entered. I really appreciated the variety. Both male and female ears. A nice party fav to send folks home with! Can definitely be reused.

I couldn't believe the price for these headbands. They worked out perfect for my son's birthday and everyone got to go home with one (and it didn't break the bank) We still have a few hanging around the house and my son wears them all the time. Quality is great.

These work perfectly for my daughters  and I with our shirts we ordered.  Since we did a 2-day pass, I was even able to switch it up with the pink headbands on day 2 with our other outfits.  Of course they aren’t the same quality as the headbands at the park it’s self but I think it’s worth the deal.  An 18 piece multi-headband set  for $9 vs 1 for $20 at the park.

Perfect for my daughters 2nd birthday. The assortment between no bow, pink bow, and red bow is great for co-ed parties and family. Fits little ones AND adults. Probably a little tighter on an adult but saves you from having to buy something separately. Durable quality. My kids left them on so they must be comfortable enough. Used in goodie bags. Qty was prefect.

reviews.t: Great welcome to our addition for my Disney classroom.
reviews.x: Every year on the first day of school my students find a set of these ears on their desk.  We all know sometimes you forget your listening ears at home,  so there’s always an extra pair in the classroom. I teach kindergarten, so these are awesome!

reviews.t: Perfect for Son’s First Birthday Party
reviews.x: We ordered these as party favors for my son’s first birthday party. The kids loved them! We felt it was the best value for how many we needed. Would definitely recommend!
[[VIDEOID:b79c3e4056706fe7c11598454ad98d82]] Thicker and nicer than what I thought. Didn’t hurt my head or any of the kids! Soft to touch.

reviews.t: Great value. But not as advertised
reviews.x: Product quality is as expected. Will work great for our Disney bounding craft. We plan to customize them. My reason for a low star rating is simply because it isn't as advertised. It says it comes with 5 red bow ears and 5 pink bow ears. Instead I received 10bred bow ears (in addition to the expected 10 plain ears). The price is fantastic and quality is not bad but just don't buy if you are wanting pink bows. Seller needs to update photo and description. Otherwise this would be a 5 star rating.

I’m a teacher so I was looking for the most bang for my money. I wanted an assortment for all in my class to choose. I got a good value overall. I got a variety of pink or red Minnie bows and Mickey ears. The ears held up but would have liked if they were more sturdy. They were soft to the touch and didn’t necessarily stick up. Disappointed that the head bands wouldn’t stay on some of their heads. It wasn’t a one size fits all, it’s a one size fits some. Still happy with the purchase.

reviews.t: Ears Were Not Glued On & Fell Apart During Party
reviews.x: Putting up party decorations, about to lay all the Mickey ears on a decorative table so our guest can get one. I open the bag of ears and what happens? The ears are falling apart! The glue has melted the ears off. I can't use 6 of them out the bat :(  So disappointed.  You better have a glue gun and 40 mins to spare if you want to enjoy all these Mickey ears. If not, your hot diggity dog party will just be a cold diggity dog disappointment :/

Worked perfect for a birthday party for my daughter! Not great quality for long term use but I should be able to get multiple parties out of them! I was looking for a few sets of ears for decorations but they cost almost as much as this set- so we got 16 and used them for guests, too. I used them them as decorations - they were flexible and they cleaned up nicely afterwards.

When I bought this product I assumed that they would be on the cheaper side of the headbands and not material. The bows are actual material they're soft velvet that go around all the headbands and the ears and they held up extremely well at a 2-year-old's birthday party. I was extremely happy with this product especially for the price.

reviews.t: Super cute Mouse ears! These are saving me a lot of time!
reviews.x: I operate a home daycare. This year,  my Halloween  theme is TLC clubhouse.  I am making all of the kids shirts kinda like the old-school Mickey Mouse club shirts. I did this theme a few years ago and I hand made the mouse ears, but decided to give these a chance instead.  I’m happy I did, they are super cute and a get price!

I was very impressed with the quality of these ears! They looked great, the ears stood up, and were super comfortable. They fit adults and young children 2 and up. I wore them all day and forgot I was even wearing them until I looked in the mirror. Highly recommend for a theme party or a family trip to Disney!

These are not high quality ears, but I purchased these for an end of the year virtual field trip to Disneyland and they were perfect for that and definitely affordable. Great party favor! Not sure I would recommend them for a trip to the parks, but definitely would recommend for fun dress up or giveaways!

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the value for the price, calling these ears a great deal for the quantity received.
Many customers say the ears fit both kids and adults, making them versatile for families and parties.
These ears are commonly used for birthday parties and Disney-themed events, with reviewers noting they were a hit.
Reviewers generally describe the quality as good and durable, with some noting they held up even with young children.
A few reviewers note the ears are smaller and lower quality than official park ears, and one reported glue and a strong smell.
